analyses.repo_description: Playwright is Microsoft's cross-browser end-to-end web testing and automation framework. This sample covers its own tests/page suite exercising check/uncheck, fill, selectOption, JS-handle serialization, and visibility queries against controlled HTML fixtures across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

properties.name: addressing-equivalence
properties.description: Different ways of identifying the same target (by value, label, index, handle, attributes, or ARIA role) resolve to the same element and produce the same effect.

properties.name: dry-run-purity
properties.description: An action that should not commit (a trial run, or a cancelled/discarded edit) performs its checks but makes no persistent state change.

properties.name: event-fidelity
properties.description: Performing the action dispatches the correct DOM events with the right type, bubbling, and composed flags, including across shadow-DOM boundaries.

properties.name: idempotence
properties.description: Applying an operation to a target that already satisfies its goal state causes no further change; doing it twice equals doing it once.

properties.name: precondition-enforcement
properties.description: Invalid targets, wrong argument types, or unsatisfiable requests are rejected with an explicit error instead of silently succeeding.

properties.name: predicate-complementarity
properties.description: Two complementary state queries are logical negations of each other: for the same element exactly one is true.

properties.name: predicate-correctness
properties.description: A boolean state query such as isVisible/isHidden accurately reflects the element's real rendered state across edge cases.

properties.name: retry-until-actionable
properties.description: The operation waits and retries while the target is not actionable (disabled, readonly, invisible, inert, or absent), has no effect during the wait, and completes once it becomes actionable.

properties.name: return-value-contract
properties.description: The operation's return value conforms to its specified shape, such as an array of the matched values or an empty array when nothing matched.

properties.name: round-trip-fidelity
properties.description: A value written or set through an action is observed unchanged through the paired read API, including normalized and empty/cleared values.

properties.name: selection-cardinality
properties.description: Single- versus multiple-selection semantics are honored: a non-multiple control keeps at most one value while a multiple control preserves the whole chosen set.

properties.name: side-effect-tolerance
properties.description: The operation completes without throwing even when it triggers page side effects such as a navigation occurring mid-operation.

properties.name: structural-preservation-under-serialization
properties.description: Transferring a value across a serialization boundary preserves its structure and semantic type, including dates and self-referential (circular) objects.

tests.name: CH-004 should not uncheck the unchecked box
tests.description: Unchecking an already-unchecked box leaves it unchecked, with no change.

tests.name: FI-020 should retry on disabled element
tests.description: Fill on a disabled input stays pending with no effect, then writes the value once enabled.

tests.name: CH-011 should throw when not a checkbox 2
tests.description: Calling check on a role=button div rejects with 'Not a checkbox or radio button'.

tests.name: CH-012 should check the box inside a button
tests.description: Checking a checkbox nested in a button makes it checked, confirmed via element.checked, page.isChecked, and handle.isChecked.

tests.name: CH-015 trial run should not uncheck
tests.description: A trial-run uncheck performs actionability checks but leaves the box checked.

tests.name: FI-004 should fill different input types
tests.description: Filling several supported input types each stores the given value.

tests.name: FI-005 should fill range input
tests.description: Filling a range input stores the given value.

tests.name: FI-008 should fill date input after clicking
tests.description: Filling a date input after clicking stores the given date.

tests.name: FI-009 input event.composed should be true and cross shadow dom boundary - ${type}
tests.description: Filling inputs fires an input event whose composed flag is true and which crosses the shadow-DOM boundary.

tests.name: FI-011 should fill month input
tests.description: Filling a month input stores the given month.

tests.name: FI-015 should fill contenteditable with new lines
tests.description: Filling a contenteditable element preserves new lines in the text.

tests.name: FI-018 should throw nice error without injected script stack when element is not an <input>
tests.description: Filling a non-input element throws a clear error without leaking injected-script stack frames.

tests.name: FI-030 should be able to clear using fill()
tests.description: Filling a value then filling an empty string clears the input.

tests.name: FI-031 should not throw when fill causes navigation
tests.description: Fill does not throw when it triggers a navigation.

tests.name: FI-033 should fill contenteditable with focus handler that collapses selection
tests.description: Fill succeeds on a contenteditable whose focus handler collapses the selection.

tests.name: SO-001 should select single option @smoke
tests.description: Selecting an option by its text stores that value and fires input/change.

tests.name: SO-003 should fall back to selecting by label
tests.description: Selecting by a human label falls back correctly to the matching option value.

tests.name: SO-004 should select single option by label
tests.description: Selecting an option by its label stores the matching value.

tests.name: SO-006 should select single option by handle
tests.description: Selecting an option by element handle stores its value.

tests.name: SO-009 should not select single option when some attributes do not match
tests.description: When attributes conflict so no option matches all, nothing is selected and the value stays empty.

tests.name: SO-011 should not throw when select causes navigation
tests.description: selectOption does not throw when it triggers a navigation.

tests.name: SO-012 should select multiple options
tests.description: On a multiple select, selecting several values stores the whole set.

tests.name: SO-014 should respect event bubbling
tests.description: selectOption fires bubbling input and change events.

tests.name: SO-017 should return an array of matched values
tests.description: selectOption returns the array of matched values.

tests.name: SO-018 should return an array of one element when multiple is not set
tests.description: On a non-multiple select, selectOption returns an array of exactly one element.

tests.name: SO-020 should not allow null items
tests.description: selectOption rejects a null item with 'expected object, got null'.

tests.name: SO-023 should deselect all options when passed no values for a select without multiple
tests.description: On a non-multiple select, passing an empty array deselects all options.

tests.name: SO-026 should wait for option to be present
tests.description: selectOption waits until a matching option is appended, then selects it.

tests.name: SO-028 should wait for multiple options to be present
tests.description: On a multiple select, selectOption waits until all requested options are present, then selects them.

tests.name: SO-031 should wait for option to be enabled
tests.description: selectOption errors while the option is disabled, then succeeds once it is enabled.

tests.name: JH-007 should work @smoke
tests.description: An evaluated object handle round-trips through jsonValue() equal to the original object.

tests.name: LO-115 isVisible and isHidden should work
tests.description: isVisible and isHidden report correctly for a visible div, an empty span, and a missing element.

tests.name: LO-117 isVisible should be true for element outside view
tests.description: An element positioned far off-screen is still reported visible.

tests.name: LO-121 isVisible and isHidden should work with list box options
tests.description: Visible and hidden option and optgroup entries are reported correctly across select variants.

tests.name: LO-124 isVisible during navigation should not throw
tests.description: isVisible returns false without throwing even while the page is navigating.

analyses.repo_description: Open MCT is NASA Ames' browser-based mission-control framework for visualizing telemetry. This dataset covers its Playwright functional e2e suite (e2e/tests/functional), which drives the real application to verify object creation, editing, persistence, visualization plugins (plots, imagery, tables, notebooks), navigation, search, and time handling.

properties.name: addressing-equivalence
properties.description: Different ways of identifying the same target (by value, label, index, handle, attributes, or ARIA role) resolve to the same element and produce the same effect.

properties.name: capability-adaptation
properties.description: The system detects whether a backend capability such as a search index is available and uses it when present, falling back to an alternative path when absent.

properties.name: debouncing
properties.description: Rapid successive inputs are coalesced, or in-flight work is aborted, so only a minimal number of downstream requests fire.

properties.name: deletion-completeness
properties.description: Removing an object eliminates every trace of it; it no longer appears in views, trees, search, or composition.

properties.name: derived-state-correctness
properties.description: A computed or derived output (such as a condition evaluation) equals the correct value for the given inputs, including the correct empty or unavailable result when inputs are missing.

properties.name: display-correctness
properties.description: A rendered UI affordance displays text or values that accurately reflect the underlying object's real state, such as its canonical hierarchical path.

properties.name: dry-run-purity
properties.description: An action that should not commit (a trial run, or a cancelled/discarded edit) performs its checks but makes no persistent state change.

properties.name: focus-on-creation
properties.description: A newly created item is automatically focused and selected so it is ready for immediate interaction.

properties.name: hover-disclosure
properties.description: A transient overlay such as a tooltip is revealed while its trigger is hovered and removed once the pointer moves away.

properties.name: idempotence
properties.description: Applying an operation to a target that already satisfies its goal state causes no further change; doing it twice equals doing it once.

properties.name: in-place-row-update
properties.description: An incoming record matching an existing row's identity key updates that row in place rather than appending a duplicate, keeping the row count stable.

properties.name: independence
properties.description: Operating on one element or object does not affect the state of sibling elements; adjacent items retain their own values.

properties.name: injection-safety
properties.description: User-supplied, exported, or linked values that could be interpreted as executable content are neutralized (stripped, escaped, prefixed, or scheme/opener-restricted) so the dangerous form is never produced.

properties.name: input-clamping
properties.description: An out-of-range input is coerced to the nearest valid value rather than rejected, so the operation still completes with a complete value.

properties.name: layout-mode-fidelity
properties.description: A selected layout mode (such as single-line versus wrap, or collapsed versus expanded) produces the corresponding rendered layout.

properties.name: navigation-correctness
properties.description: Activating a navigational affordance (link, breadcrumb, or menu entry) brings the application to the intended target, reflected in the URL or active view.

properties.name: ordering-correctness
properties.description: Items are rendered in the order dictated by the active sort or priority rule, and re-sort correctly when the sort key changes.

properties.name: override-precedence
properties.description: When multiple sources could set the same value, the higher-priority source takes effect and overrides the others.

properties.name: persistence-across-reload
properties.description: State created or edited in one session survives a page reload or renavigation and is read back unchanged.

properties.name: precondition-enforcement
properties.description: Invalid targets, wrong argument types, or unsatisfiable requests are rejected with an explicit error instead of silently succeeding.

properties.name: predicate-complementarity
properties.description: Two complementary state queries are logical negations of each other: for the same element exactly one is true.

properties.name: predicate-correctness
properties.description: A boolean state query such as isVisible/isHidden accurately reflects the element's real rendered state across edge cases.

properties.name: render-invariant
properties.description: The low-level rendered geometry upholds an expected invariant (monotonic ordering, no coordinate truncation, no stale-offset collapse) regardless of input quirks.

properties.name: representation-consistency
properties.description: The same object renders the same value across different representations or view states, such as a collapsed versus an expanded legend.

properties.name: request-minimality
properties.description: An interaction issues no redundant backend requests and coalesces multiple items' data needs into a single batched request where possible.

properties.name: responsive-relayout
properties.description: Rendered content repositions, rescales, or reprioritizes to stay correct and within the visible area when the viewport or container is resized.

properties.name: return-value-contract
properties.description: The operation's return value conforms to its specified shape, such as an array of the matched values or an empty array when nothing matched.

properties.name: reversibility
properties.description: An operation has an inverse that restores the prior state, so forward-then-inverse returns the system to where it started.

properties.name: round-trip-fidelity
properties.description: A value written or set through an action is observed unchanged through the paired read API, including normalized and empty/cleared values.

properties.name: safe-state-fallback
properties.description: When a configuration cannot be applied or is absent, the system falls back to a well-defined safe default state rather than failing or behaving unpredictably.

properties.name: scroll-reachability
properties.description: Content that overflows its container can be scrolled until off-screen content is brought into the viewport.

properties.name: selection-cardinality
properties.description: Single- versus multiple-selection semantics are honored: a non-multiple control keeps at most one value while a multiple control preserves the whole chosen set.

properties.name: side-effect-tolerance
properties.description: The operation completes without throwing even when it triggers page side effects such as a navigation occurring mid-operation.

properties.name: structural-preservation-under-serialization
properties.description: Transferring a value across a serialization boundary preserves its structure and semantic type, including dates and self-referential (circular) objects.

properties.name: time-windowed-retention
properties.description: Data whose timestamp falls outside the active time window is discarded from the view while in-window data is retained.

properties.name: trusted-input-activation
properties.description: User-provided content is promoted to an interactive form only when it satisfies validity or allow-list criteria, and is rendered inert otherwise.

properties.name: user-feedback-indication
properties.description: An action surfaces appropriate user feedback (a progress indicator, an advisory notice, or a transient status indicator) shown while or after the action and cleared when no longer relevant.

properties.name: write-minimality
properties.description: A single logical change produces exactly one persistence operation, with no redundant or duplicate writes.

tests.name: display correct paths when hovering tree items
tests.description: Hovering tree items shows a tooltip with the object's correct path.

tests.name: Editing object properties should generate a single persistence operation
tests.description: Saving one edit to a Clock's properties issues exactly one PUT request, with no duplicate persistence operations.

tests.name: cancelling form does not set bounds
tests.description: Discarding the time-conductor form leaves the bounds unchanged; only submitting applies them.

tests.name: preserve offsets and url params when switching between fixed and real-time mode
tests.description: Real-time offsets and their URL parameters survive switching to fixed mode and back, round-tripping unchanged and staying reflected in the URL.

tests.name: Validate single object in search result @couchdb @network
tests.description: A query matching exactly one object returns a single result containing that object's name.

tests.name: fall-back on base index if index not available @couchdb @network
tests.description: When the object_names index is absent (404), search falls back to the _find query and still returns results.

tests.name: Search results are debounced @couchdb @network
tests.description: Typing a query quickly is debounced into a single batched search request rather than one per keystroke.

tests.name: Validate multiple objects in search results return partial matches
tests.description: A partial (prefix) query returns every object whose name matches, and only those.

tests.name: Log Plot ticks are functionally correct in regular and log mode and after refresh
tests.description: Asserts the plot's Y ticks are the correct values in regular mode and log mode, toggling log on and off and after saving restores the appropriate ticks each time.

tests.name: Plots do not re-request data when a plot is clicked
tests.description: Asserts that clicking on a plot canvas fires no historical-data network request.

tests.name: Verify sub-millisecond timeline coordinate precision under high-magnitude offsets (Micro-Zoom Mode)
tests.description: Asserts that under a hyper-zoomed 10ms range at 1000Hz the WebGL vertex buffers show no stair-stepping (no consecutive duplicate relative-X coordinates from truncation).

tests.name: Export as JPG, will suggest the correct default filename
tests.description: Asserts that exporting a single plot as JPG suggests the filename '<name> - plot.jpeg'.

tests.name: Export as PNG, will suggest the correct default filename
tests.description: Asserts that exporting an overlay plot as PNG suggests the filename '<name> - plot.png'.

tests.name: Export as PNG, will suggest the correct default filename
tests.description: Asserts that exporting a stacked plot as PNG suggests the filename '<name> - stacked-plot.png'.

tests.name: We can preview plot in display layouts
tests.description: Asserts that a telemetry object placed in a display layout can be previewed as a plot canvas via the context menu, the large-view control, and the tree, and as both numeric and overlay-plot view types.

tests.name: Tags work with Overlay Plots
tests.description: Asserts that tags added to an overlay plot pass the basic add/verify/remove checks, apply to its telemetry item, and that searching for a tag locates the tagged item (pausing the real-time plot).

tests.name: Tags work with Plot View of telemetry items
tests.description: Asserts that tags added on a plot view of a telemetry item pass the basic add/verify/remove checks.

tests.name: Tags work with Stacked Plots
tests.description: Asserts that tags added to a stacked plot pass the basic add/verify/remove checks and apply to its telemetry item.

tests.name: Plot time-series ticks are functionally correct over a period of 6 months, between two years
tests.description: Asserts the plot's X-axis time ticks have the correct count and month-boundary labels for a six-month range spanning two years.

tests.name: Plot time-series ticks are functionally correct over a period of days
tests.description: Asserts the plot's X-axis time ticks have the correct count and date labels for a multi-week range.

tests.name: Plot time-series ticks are functionally correct over a period of hours
tests.description: Asserts the plot's X-axis time ticks have the correct count and labels for an eight-hour range.

tests.name: Plot time-series ticks are functionally correct over a period of minutes
tests.description: Asserts the plot's X-axis time ticks have the correct count and labels for a twenty-minute range.

tests.name: Plot time-series ticks are functionally correct over a period of seconds
tests.description: Asserts the plot's X-axis time ticks have the correct count and labels for a one-minute range.

tests.name: Can count up from a target date
tests.description: Asserts that a timer with a past target date shows a plus/count-up direction and its seconds value increases over time.

tests.name: Folder view persists when navigating away and back
tests.description: Asserts that a folder switched to List view stays in List view after navigating away to another object and back.

tests.name: Default and new sections are automatically named Unnamed Section with Unnamed Page
tests.description: Asserts that both the default section/page and a newly added section/page are automatically named 'Unnamed Section' and 'Unnamed Page'.

tests.name: can export notebook as text
tests.description: Asserts that exporting a notebook as text produces a download whose contents contain the entered entry text.

tests.name: When a new entry is created, it should be focused and selected
tests.description: Asserts that a newly created notebook entry is focused with its input visible and carries the is-selected class.

tests.name: When an object is dropped into a notebook, a new entry is created and it should be focused
tests.description: Asserts that dropping an object onto a notebook creates a new entry embed with the object's correct icon and name.

tests.name: when an invalid link is entered into a notebook entry, it does not become clickable when viewing
tests.description: Asserts that a link missing its protocol typed into an entry is not rendered as a clickable anchor.

tests.name: when a valid secure link is entered into a notebook entry, it becomes clickable when viewing
tests.description: Asserts that a valid secure https whitelisted link typed into an entry renders as a clickable anchor that opens the target in a popup.

tests.name: Prevents pasting text into selected notebook entry if not editing
tests.description: Asserts that pasting into a committed, non-editing notebook entry has no effect and does not duplicate its text.

tests.name: When changing the name of a notebook in the browse bar, new notebook changes are not lost
tests.description: Asserts that renaming a notebook twice in the browse bar updates the tree and browse bar name while a newly entered entry is preserved.

tests.name: A snapshot can be Viewed, Annotated, display deleted, and saved from Container with 3 dot action menu
tests.description: Asserts that a snapshot can be viewed, text-annotated via Painterro, saved, and reopened with the annotated image still shown.

tests.name: Can load tags
tests.description: Asserts that the Add Tag autocomplete lists the available tags Science, Drilling, and Driving.

tests.name: Can cancel adding tags
tests.description: Asserts that cancelling tag entry (by clicking the search input) at two different points restores the Add Tag button without adding a tag.

tests.name: Tags persist across reload
tests.description: Asserts that tags applied to multiple notebook entries remain present after a page reload.

tests.name: Search tests
tests.description: Asserts that a partial tag search against the CouchDB backend returns only the matching tag and shows 'No results found' for a non-matching query.

tests.name: Can be renamed @addInit
tests.description: Asserts that the browse bar displays the restricted notebook's renamed name.

tests.name: Disallows embeds to be deleted if page locked @addInit
tests.description: Asserts that an embed on a locked page does not offer a 'Remove This Embed' action.

tests.name: basic functionality
tests.description: Asserts that exporting a restricted notebook as text produces a download whose contents contain the entered entry text.

tests.name: Changing the displayed tab should not be persisted if the view is locked
tests.description: Asserts that tab changes are not persisted across navigation when the view is locked but are persisted when it is unlocked.

tests.name: Eager Load Tabs is the default and then can be toggled off
tests.description: Asserts that the Eager Load Tabs property defaults to unchecked and can be toggled on, with the checkbox reflecting the change.

tests.name: Can add and remove telemetry sources
tests.description: Adds a telemetry source to a gauge, replaces it with a second one (single-source replace modal), and deletes it, verifying the elements pool updates accordingly.

tests.name: Gauge does not display NaN when data not available
tests.description: Verifies that a gauge whose telemetry source is delayed displays a placeholder rather than NaN when no data is available.

tests.name: Gauge does not break when an object is missing
tests.description: Removes a gauge's telemetry object from local storage and confirms the gauge still adjusts time bounds and throws no page errors.

tests.name: Gauge enforces composition policy
tests.description: Verifies the gauge rejects disallowed child types (Folder, Display Layout) by keeping the Save button disabled.

tests.name: Can right click on image and open it in a new tab @2p
tests.description: Right-clicks the image, confirms the context menu, and opens the image in a new tab whose URL points at the .jpg.

tests.name: Can adjust image brightness/contrast by dragging the sliders
tests.description: Adjusts image brightness and contrast by dragging the sliders and asserts the resulting CSS filter values.

tests.name: Resizing the layout changes thumbnail visibility and size
tests.description: Resizes the imagery object's height and verifies the thumbnail strip's visibility and small-vs-regular size change accordingly.

tests.name: Imagery View operations
tests.description: Runs the full imagery view operations (zoom, pan, image navigation, out-of-bounds image discard, brightness/contrast) in a tabs-view context.

tests.name: Imagery View operations
tests.description: Runs the full imagery view operations (zoom, pan, image navigation, out-of-bounds image discard, brightness/contrast) on the imagery inside a tabs view.

tests.name: Clicking a thumbnail loads the image in large view
tests.description: Hovers to reveal a timestrip thumbnail, clicks it to open the large view, and verifies the large image is the same image as the clicked thumbnail.

tests.name: Get background-image url from background-image css prop @clock
tests.description: Reads the focused image's background-image URL and verifies it changes to the latest image after the clock advances.

tests.name: Imagery Time Bounding @clock
tests.description: Advances the mocked clock in a flexible layout and verifies out-of-bounds image thumbnails are discarded while in-bounds ones remain.

tests.name: poll question indicator remains when blank poll set
tests.description: Verifies the poll question indicator remains visible after setting a blank poll question.

tests.name: operator status table reflects answered values
tests.description: Sets and changes the operator's status and verifies the manage-poll status table reflects the selected value each time.

tests.name: Poll indicator is visible when window is really small
tests.description: Shrinks the viewport and verifies the poll indicator remains visible and within the viewport with indicators expanded.

tests.name: indicates when telemetry is stale and clears staleness when telemetry is not stale
tests.description: Verifies the object view gains the is-stale class when telemetry goes stale and loses it when telemetry becomes fresh again.

tests.name: Bar Graph can be given a fixed Y axis range
tests.description: Sets a fixed Y-axis range on a Bar Graph, then verifies Plotly renders that range and the persisted configuration stores the values and autoscale=false.

tests.name: Scatter Plot can be given fixed X and Y axis ranges
tests.description: Sets fixed X and Y ranges on a Scatter Plot and verifies both the rendered Plotly ranges and the persisted configuration match the entered bounds.

tests.name: Fixed scaling is read-only outside of edit mode
tests.description: After saving a fixed range, verifies that in browse mode the axis-scaling values render as static text rather than editable form controls.

tests.name: A fixed range applies to a Scatter Plot with no data yet
tests.description: Verifies a fixed Y range is applied to a Scatter Plot that has no telemetry data yet.

tests.name: Re-enabling auto scale returns the axis to automatic ranging
tests.description: Sets a fixed range then re-checks auto scale and verifies the axis returns to automatic ranging.

tests.name: A fixed range takes precedence over Scatter Plot underlay ranges
tests.description: Verifies underlay ranges drive the axes while auto scale is on, but a configured fixed range takes precedence over them.

tests.name: Bar Graph Y axis can be drawn on a log scale
tests.description: Enables Y-axis log mode on a Bar Graph and verifies the rendered axis type is log and the configuration persists logMode=true.

tests.name: Scatter Plot Y axis can be drawn on a log scale
tests.description: Enables Y-axis log mode on a Scatter Plot and verifies the Y axis becomes log while the X axis stays linear.

tests.name: A fixed range is given to Plotly in log units
tests.description: Verifies a log-mode fixed range of 1 to 1000 reaches Plotly as exponents [0, 3] while the configuration still stores the raw data-unit values.

tests.name: A log axis can be anchored and labelled at zero
tests.description: Verifies a zero-anchored log axis renders explicit tick labels starting at 0, stays fixed (not autoranged), and persists its range.

tests.name: Enabling log mode clamps a negative minimum to zero
tests.description: Enables log mode with a negative minimum and verifies the minimum is clamped to zero, the range stays fixed, and the clamped value persists.

tests.name: Enabling log mode re-enables auto scale for a range entirely below zero
tests.description: Enables log mode on a range entirely below zero and verifies auto scale is re-enabled with an explanatory notice and persisted as autoscale=true.

tests.name: can add/remove Ellipse to a single layout
tests.description: Adds then removes an Ellipse drawing element in both parent and child layouts, asserting it appears and then disappears.

tests.name: alpha-numeric widget telemetry value exactly matches latest telemetry value received in fixed time
tests.description: Adds a Sine Wave Generator to a display layout and verifies the alpha-numeric widget displays exactly the latest telemetry value in fixed time mode.

tests.name: items in a display layout can be removed with object tree context menu when viewing the display layout
tests.description: Removes a layout item via the object-tree context menu while viewing the layout and verifies the frame count drops to zero.

tests.name: Same objects with different request options have unique subscriptions
tests.description: Adds the same state generator to two tables with opposite filters and verifies neither table ever shows the other's filtered values, confirming independent subscriptions.

tests.name: Conditional styling, using a Condition Set, will style correctly based on the output @clock
tests.description: Drives a condition set from a state generator and verifies a box's background color switches to red when the state is OFF and back to default when ON.

tests.name: Shows correct output when no staleness rule is applied
tests.description: Verifies a condition widget's rendered output label matches the condition set's current output as telemetry changes, with no staleness rule applied.

tests.name: styling the flexible layout properly applies the styles to flex layout
tests.description: Sets border, background, and text colors on a flexible layout, verifies they apply, and verifies they persist after reload.

tests.name: when the "no style" option is selected, background and text should be reset to inherited styles
tests.description: Applies styles then selects the No Style option and verifies background and text reset to inherited defaults, persisting after reload.

tests.name: styling the overlay plot properly applies the styles to all containers
tests.description: Sets colors and fonts on a stacked plot, verifies they apply and persist after reload, and verifies child items inherit only the text properties.

tests.name: styles button only appears when appropriate component selected
tests.description: Verifies the Styles tab is shown when a styleable layout or plot is selected and hidden when a non-styleable container is selected.

tests.name: Displays all plan events
tests.description: Navigates to a Gantt Chart and asserts every activity from the imported plan is rendered.

tests.name: Displays all plan events
tests.description: Asserts all activities of a plan are rendered in the plan view.

tests.name: will scale activities properly in the Time Strip View
tests.description: Shrinks the viewport in the Time Strip View and asserts all activities remain scaled within the visible area.

tests.name: Time strip now line
tests.description: Asserts the now marker is visible in real-time mode and hidden when the current time falls outside the fixed time axis.

tests.name: Condition set object properties persist in main view and inspector after reload @localStorage
tests.description: Asserts a condition set's name in the main view and inspector survives a page reload unchanged.

tests.name: condition set object can be modified on @localStorage
tests.description: Renames a condition set and asserts the new name appears in the main view, inspector, tree, and search, and persists after reload.

tests.name: ConditionSet should display appropriate view options
tests.description: Adds telemetry to a condition set and asserts the view switcher offers the expected views and each selected view renders.

tests.name: ConditionSet has correct outputs when test data is enabled
tests.description: Configures a condition set with test data enabled and asserts it evaluates to the correct output value.

tests.name: should toggle shouldFetchHistorical property in inspector
tests.description: Toggles the shouldFetchHistorical config on then off and asserts the persisted object property matches each state.

tests.name: You can remove telemetry from a condition set with existing conditions
tests.description: Removes a telemetry object from a condition set and asserts it no longer appears in the Elements inspector list.

tests.name: ConditionSet should display appropriate view options
tests.description: Adds telemetry to a condition set and asserts the view switcher offers the expected views and each selected view renders.

tests.name: Short circuit evaluation does not cause incorrect evaluation https://github.com/nasa/openmct/issues/7992
tests.description: Drives test-data inputs across values and asserts the active condition name matches the correct condition for each input combination.

tests.name: When selecting a fault, it has an "is-selected" class and its information shows in the inspector
tests.description: Selects a single fault and asserts it gains the is-selected class and its details appear in the inspector.

tests.name: Allows you to shelve multiple faults
tests.description: Shelves two faults and asserts both leave the standard view and appear in the shelved view.

tests.name: Allows you to search faults
tests.description: Searches faults by namespace, name, and trigger time and asserts only matching faults are shown, with all restored when cleared.

tests.name: Rows are updatable in place
tests.description: Verifies a later telemetry datum matching an existing row's key merges into that row in place rather than appending a new row.

tests.name: Create new Sine Wave Generator Object and validate create Form Logic
tests.description: Creates a Sine Wave Generator and validates the create form's input logic.

tests.name: If empty selector is provided, throws an error
tests.description: Asserts that starting Open MCT with an empty selector throws an 'Invalid HTML element or selector' error and does not render.

tests.name: Create a basic object and verify that it can be linked to another folder
tests.description: Verifies Save is disabled for invalid link targets and that linking a folder to My Items succeeds.

tests.name: Columns/Rows Layout Toggle
tests.description: Verifies toggling to rows layout and back to columns layout restores the original orientation.

tests.name: Create a basic object and verify that it can be exported as JSON from Tree
tests.description: Exports a folder as JSON from the tree context menu and verifies the file preserves the object's name and type.

tests.name: Create a basic object and verify that it can be exported as JSON from 3 dot menu
tests.description: Exports a folder as JSON from the 3-dot menu and verifies the file preserves the object's name and type.

tests.name: Verify that a nested Object can be exported as JSON
tests.description: Exports a folder containing a nested timer and verifies both objects and the folder's composition are preserved in the JSON.

tests.name: Verify that the ExportAsJSON dropdown does not appear for the item X
tests.description: Verifies the Export as JSON action is absent for a non-composable Fault Management object.

tests.name: Verify that the ExportAsJSON action creates a progressbar
tests.description: Verifies a large JSON export surfaces a progress bar and advisory message while the download runs.

tests.name: in edit mode, LAD Tables provide ability to hide columns
tests.description: Verifies LAD table column checkboxes hide and show columns and that the visibility state persists across save and reload.

tests.name: LAD Tables don't allow selection of rows but does show context click menus
tests.description: Verifies LAD table rows are not text-selectable (user-select none) yet still expose the expected right-click context menu items.

tests.name: telemetry value exactly matches latest telemetry value received in realtime mode
tests.description: Verifies the LAD table value exactly matches the latest telemetry value received in real-time mode.

tests.name: Ensure we have numbers in cells
tests.description: Verifies each LAD Table Set cell renders a finite numeric telemetry value rather than a placeholder.

tests.name: on load, auto scrolls to top for descending, and to bottom for ascending
tests.description: Verifies the table auto-scrolls to top for descending sort and to bottom for ascending sort, with the sort direction persisting across renavigation.

tests.name: Supports filtering telemetry by regular text search
tests.description: Verifies a plain-text filter shows only rows matching the term and yields no rows when none match.

tests.name: CSV export does not prefix the Name column for non-formula-injection object names
tests.description: Verifies CSV export leaves non-formula-like object names unprefixed, complementing the formula-injection escaping case.

tests.name: Verify that the create button appears and that the Folder Domain Object is available for selection
tests.description: Verifies the Create button opens a menu in which the Folder domain object is available for selection.

tests.name: Closing notification list after notification banner disappeared does not cause it to open automatically
tests.description: After dismissing a notification banner and closing the notification list, editing and saving an object does not cause the notification list to reopen automatically.

tests.name: Verify that user can use the datepicker in the TC
tests.description: Opening the Time Conductor datepicker shows the dialog, and selecting a date cell closes it.

tests.name: Clicking on an object in the path of a recent object navigates to the object
tests.description: Clicking an ancestor object in a recent object's breadcrumb path navigates to that object and updates the hash URL accordingly.

tests.name: Clicking on the 'target button' scrolls the object into view in the tree and highlights it
tests.description: Clicking a recent object's target button expands its parent folder, scrolls the item into view, and briefly highlights it before the highlight is removed.

tests.name: Displays objects and aliases uniquely
tests.description: Creating an alias via the link action produces a distinct recent-objects entry marked as an alias whose breadcrumb path differs from the original object's.

tests.name: Creating a child object on one tab and expanding its parent on the other shows the correct composition @2p
tests.description: A folder created on one tab becomes visible in the tree of a second tab after expanding the parent folder.

tests.name: Opening and closing an item before the request has been fulfilled will abort the request @couchdb @network
tests.description: Rapidly double-clicking to expand then collapse a folder before its request resolves aborts the in-flight _all_docs network request.

tests.name: Show a new root object when added asynchronously
tests.description: Adding a root object asynchronously after load makes it appear in the tree.

tests.name: Content in inspector can be scrolled to vertically
tests.description: Scrolling the overflowing inspector properties panel brings the last property value, initially out of the viewport, into view.

tests.name: Inspector tabs show the correct tabs per view and mode
tests.description: For each view type the inspector shows the expected number and order of tabs in browse mode and in edit mode.

tests.name: allows wrapping to span multiple lines
tests.description: In multi-line mode the indicators container grows taller when the viewport is resized so indicators wrap to multiple lines.

tests.name: collapse/expand toggle and single/multi line toggle work in conjunction
tests.description: The collapse/expand and single/multi line toggles combine so that the indicators container renders at the layout height corresponding to the active mode combination.

tests.name: collapse/expand toggle and single/multi line toggle state saved in local storage
tests.description: The collapse/expand and single/multi line toggle states are saved and restored after a page reload.
